# ThreeUI Community / Sylva

Source: https://github.com/MengTo/threeui/tree/68802d5428071ada5c20db8094b1649e6bb770ed

Version: Community 1.2.0, MIT, © 2026 Meng To. The LICENSE in this folder applies to the adapted scene.

Original complete page: `public/landing-pages/inner-green-3d.html`.
Actual derived scene: `/public/scenes/sylva/scene.js`.

Preserved procedural geometry, shaders, material/lighting, original quality tiers and pointer/butterfly/scan behavior. Ethan's additions are DOM composition, lifecycle, validated frame handshake, diagnostics and a small scroll camera offset.

The former Gallery / AnimatedTopDock adaptation is preserved in the site's Git history. Full current source audit: `/THIRD_PARTY.md`.
